Digital Data Farm (DDF) - Odoo 10 Integration

Base URL: https://apy.digitaldatafarm.com

Connection

{"api_key": "YOUR_API_KEY"}

Header: Authorization: API-KEY <api_key>

DDF: Get Plots (manual)

Fetches plots, dataloggers and their channels; produces a JSON attachment. If the API fails for an individual datalogger, its mp_id is preserved in the report and its HTTP failures/redirects are listed under error/attempts.

Each datalogger has device_remotecontrol_params and each channel has sensor_remotecontrol_params, ready for copying into Odoo.

Required configuration

mdm.measurement.device.remotecontrol_params:

{"datalogger_id": 1389, "start_date": "2026-01-01"}

datalogger_id = DDF mp_id. start_date is optional (used only before the first reading).

mdm.measurement.device.sensor.remotecontrol_params:

{"sensor_id": 23695}

sensor_id = DDF dc_id. Both IDs are provider-side IDs (NOT the Odoo database record IDs).

Endpoints

  • GET /plots/
  • GET /plots/{plot_id}
  • GET /dataloggers/{mp_id}/
  • GET /dataloggers/{mp_id}/device_channel/{dc_id}/data

The discovery action tests both trailing-slash variants for 307/308/404/405 and logs errors. It does not follow redirects to arbitrary hosts.

DDF: Daily Sync

Step 10 builds a plan from configured sensors. Step 20 imports readings, starting at the last reading, or at start_date, or at January 1st of the current year. API date ranges are divided into 30-day requests.

Note: this discovery action does not create Odoo devices or sensors; it only reports their necessary mapping. Check issues before using the report.

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
remote = self.remote_id cfg = {} try: cfg = json.loads(remote.connection_params or '{}') except Exception: cfg = {} api_key = (cfg.get('api_key') or '').strip() if not api_key: raise Exception("Missing DDF api_key in connection_params.") headers = {'Authorization': 'API-KEY %s' % api_key} base = (base_url or '').rstrip('/')
sensors_plan = bag.get('sensors_plan') or [] if not sensors_plan: raise Exception("No sensors_plan found in bag. Run Get Devices (plan) first.")
today = fields.Date.today() total_upserts = 0 total_errors = 0 items = []
for plan_item in sensors_plan: sensor_id = plan_item.get('sensor_id') datalogger_id = plan_item.get('datalogger_id') sensor_id_param = plan_item.get('sensor_id_param') initial_date = plan_item.get('initial_date')
if not (sensor_id and datalogger_id and sensor_id_param and initial_date): continue
upserts = 0 errs = 0 urls_called = []
try: current_dt = datetime.strptime(initial_date, '%Y-%m-%d') except Exception: continue end_dt = datetime.strptime(today, '%Y-%m-%d')
while current_dt <= end_dt: chunk_end = min(current_dt + timedelta(days=30), end_dt) start_str = current_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') end_str = chunk_end.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') start_iso = '%sT00:00:00.000Z' % start_str end_iso = '%sT00:00:00.000Z' % end_str url = '%s/dataloggers/%s/device_channel/%s/data?start_date=%s&end_date=%s' % ( base, datalogger_id, sensor_id_param, start_iso, end_iso) urls_called.append(url)
try: resp = request_retry('GET', url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout) if resp.status_code >= 400: errs += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'datalogger_id': datalogger_id, 'sensor_id_param': sensor_id_param, 'url': url, 'status': resp.status_code, 'error': (resp.text or '')[:400], }) else: channel_data = (resp.json() or {}).get('channel_data') or [] for entry in channel_data: try: unix_ts = entry[0] value = float(entry[1]) utc_dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(unix_ts, tz=pytz.UTC) ts_str = utc_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', {'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'measurement_time': ts_str}, {'value': value}, ) upserts += 1 except Exception: errs += 1 except Exception as e: errs += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'datalogger_id': datalogger_id, 'sensor_id_param': sensor_id_param, 'url': url, 'status': -1, 'error': str(e), })
current_dt = chunk_end + timedelta(days=1)
total_upserts += upserts total_errors += errs items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'datalogger_id': datalogger_id, 'sensor_id_param': sensor_id_param, 'upserts': upserts, 'errors': errs, 'urls': urls_called, })
audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'items': items, } b64 = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode('utf-8')) fname = 'ddf_readings_%s.json' % fields.Datetime.now().replace(':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_') att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': remote.id, }) remote.message_post( body=u'[DDF] upserts=%s errors=%s' % (total_upserts, total_errors), attachment_ids=[att.id] ) bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors bag['audit_attachment_id'] = att.id
